question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The literary critic's _____ analysis of postmodern novels challenged the traditional notions of narrative structure and authorial intent.
solution:
The correct answer is '**hermeneutic**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**hermeneutic**" refers to the interpretation and study of literary texts, especially in relation to meaning and context.
 
• The critic's analysis was deep and interpretative, aligning well with the concept of hermeneutics.
 
• Other options like "**facile**" (superficial), "**pedantic**" (overly concerned with details), and "**prosaic**" (ordinary) do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The literary critic's hermeneutic__ analysis of postmodern novels challenged the traditional notions of narrative structure and authorial intent.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Facile (सरल)**: means superficial or easily achieved.
 
• **Pedantic (पांडित्यपूर्ण)**: means overly concerned with minor details or formal rules.
 
• **Prosaic (सामान्य)**: means dull or lacking in imagination.
